question: Amongst six friends, G, K, M, P, R, and V, each has a different height. R is shorter than K but taller than V, who is taller than G. P is taller than M but shorter than G. Who is the shortest of all six friends?
solution:
**Given:** Amongst six friends, G, K, M, P, R, and V, each has a different height. 

1) R is shorter than K but taller than V, who is taller than G. 

K > R > V > G

2) P is taller than M but shorter than G.

K > R > V > G > P > M

Thus, according to the final arrangement is the shortest of all six friends.

Hence, **"Option 4" **is the correct answer.
